theorem odd_gcd {a b : ℕ} (ha : Odd a) (hb : Odd b) : Odd (Nat.gcd a b) := by
  rw [Nat.odd_iff_not_even]
  rw [Nat.odd_iff_not_even] at ha hb
  rw [Nat.even_iff]
  rw [Nat.even_iff] at ha hb
  have h : (a % 2 = 1) ∧ (b % 2 = 1) := ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
  have h' : Nat.gcd a b % 2 = 1 := by
    have h₁ : a % 2 = 1 := h.1
    have h₂ : b % 2 = 1 := h.2
    have h₃ : Nat.gcd a b % 2 = 1 := by
      -- Use the fact that gcd is odd if both inputs are odd
      have h₄ : Nat.gcd a b % 2 = 1 := by
        cases' a with a
        · simp_all
        cases' b with b
        · simp_all
        simp_all [Nat.gcd_eq_right, Nat.gcd_eq_left]
        <;> omega
      exact h₄
    exact h₃
  omega
